notes.title: Update: Mercy is now a thing
notes.notes:
So it turns out that not all gamers are psychopaths! A number of you reached out to me, asking to not have to kill your friends. So now you can not murder innocent beings.
Yay!

*Note: There still are some unavoidable fights, but I'm working on those

Also, more bug fixes! You guys are super observant, and I am honored to have you playing this weird thing I made.
Thanks,
Yitz

notes.title: Bug fixes - yay!
notes.notes:
I fixed some bugs today! Thanks to everyone who messaged me about it.
Also, the endings and credits have been very slightly altered, for reasons that should make sense over time. [insert self-deprecating joke here]
-Yitz
